title: Family parties and her first dances
summary: She first danced after marriage; garden parties and family holidays.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Even that old-time music, you never heard any of the early dance bands then, or did you, but... Where? I guess you weren't... Did you go to any dances when you grew up? Nothing, but after I was married.

After you were married. After I married the books from my first husband, I went to dances. I had never been out there dancing or anything before then. Parties at different people's backyards. Yeah. We'd go to parties like that long hair.

Garden parties, things in the backyard all the time. And I mean, on holidays and like First of July and Labor Day and things like that, we'd have the whole family together. Looked like my grandmother was sitting up there like the queen, all her kids would come in. She expected them, and it didn't disappoint her either.
